newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung unit in $100 mln chemical export deal.
newsitem.headline: Samsung unit in $100 mln chemical export deal.

text.p: Samsung General Chemicals Co, a unit of South Korea's Samsung Group, said on Tuesday it has agreed to supply $100 million worth of styrene monomers to U.S.'s Tauber Oil Co Ltd over the next three years.
Samsung said in a statement it would provide 180,000 tonnes of styrene monomers to Tauber Oil during the period.
Styrene monomer is used as a feed product to make acrylonitrile butadiene styrene and polystyrene, which are then used as basic chemical materials in electric, automobile and electronics industry.
